# Vice Meridian

[![make.fun · gta6-01](https://make.fun/badge/gta6-01.svg)](https://make.fun/bounty/gta6-01?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=gta6-01)
[![rank](https://make.fun/badge/gta6-01/kysoog/gta6-6ix-streets-v2/rank.svg)](https://make.fun/bounty/gta6-01/leaderboard?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=gta6-01)
[![reward](https://make.fun/badge/gta6-01/kysoog/gta6-6ix-streets-v2/reward.svg)](https://make.fun/bounty/gta6-01?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=gta6-01)

Entry for the make.fun bounty [Make GTA 6](https://make.fun/bounty/gta6-01): an open-world crime sandbox in the browser, built on three.js r160 — Miami Vice palette, art-deco blocks, drivable car, chase camera, traffic, HUD and minimap.

`Vice Meridian` — see the repository's [README.md](../README.md) for the controls, the tech notes and the headless capture command.
